title: Peanut Butter Protein Overnight Oats
subtitle: No-cook overnight oats built with Greek yogurt and peanut butter for a grab-and-go breakfast.
description: Rolled oats soak overnight in milk and Greek yogurt with peanut butter and a touch of honey, then get topped with banana and extra peanut butter in the morning. No stove time and no line — just jars in the fridge.

steps.title: Whisk the base
steps.instruction: Whisk milk, Greek yogurt, peanut butter, honey, and vanilla in a large bowl or pitcher until the peanut butter is fully incorporated and no streaks remain.

steps.title: Add the oats
steps.instruction: Stir in rolled oats until evenly coated in the peanut butter-yogurt mixture.

steps.title: Portion into jars
steps.instruction: Divide the mixture evenly into 8 jars or containers with lids. Seal and refrigerate at least 6 hours, or overnight, until the oats soften and thicken.

steps.title: Top and serve
steps.instruction: Stir each jar before eating — the mixture settles overnight. Top with sliced banana and an extra spoonful of peanut butter if desired.

stationWorkflow: Batch-mix the base the night before so morning service is just grab-and-go.
Keep jars labeled with the date; overnight oats are best within 4 days.
Set out banana and extra peanut butter as optional toppings rather than mixing them in ahead.
cleanupNotes: Rinse peanut butter measuring cups immediately in hot water before it hardens on the sides.
Wash jars right after emptying — dried oat residue is much harder to scrub off once set.
leftovers: Keeps well sealed in the refrigerator up to 4 days.
If oats thicken too much overnight, stir in a splash of milk before eating.
